title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1905 15th Street in Boulder, Colorado, as the "Officer Eric H. Talley Post Office Building".
official_summary: This bill designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1905 15th Street in Boulder, Colorado, as the Officer Eric H. Talley Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A law names the Boulder, Colorado post office building after Officer Eric H. Talley.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1905 15th Street in Boulder, Colorado, as the Officer Eric H. Talley Post Office Building. It is a naming measure and does not change postal services, rules, or funding.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on March 10, 2022.
